project.name: DoRoboty.ai
project.industry_or_domain: job marketplace prototype for AI roles

brief.problem_statement: Design a survey for the Apply role based on current AI job requirements and candidate/recruiter needs.
brief.working_hypothesis: The current CV and short-answer application flow may not capture the evidence requested for AI-native roles.
brief.decision_at_stake: Which application fields or guidance to test next.

research_questions.question: What evidence do current AI Apply roles ask candidates to provide?
Which survey questions identify gaps for candidates and screeners?

brief.disconfirmation_criterion: If candidates and recruiters do not name the same missing evidence, do not add a new mandatory application field.
brief.population_or_setting: Polish AI/UX/product job seekers and first-screening recruiters.

scholar_subagent.summary: Live web search returned no results in this session.

answers_per_question: Current listings ask for inspectable evidence of AI-assisted work, adapted to seniority.
The survey tests whether the application captures that evidence and supports rapid screening.
synthesis.strongest_challenge: The reviewed offers are not a representative sample.
synthesis.decision_implication: Test guidance and optional structured evidence before adding mandatory fields.

report.tldr_one_liner: Survey candidates and screeners about missing evidence of real AI work, especially portfolio, outcome and production context.
